result.title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
result.summary: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出前馈式 4D 驾驶场景重建框架，用实例先验蒸馏约束动态掩码学习，并以稀疏 LiDAR 深度锚定 Gaussian 位置，以缓解动态/静态语义泄漏与跨视角几何漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究目标是驾驶场景的 3D/4D 几何重建，不涉及 VLM 内部 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或推理停止决策，其深度锚定与实例先验蒸馏也难以提供针对 LVR 的具体方法线索，故排除。
